releaseStatus: local implementation; no release requested or deployed

selection.basis: Expand beyond the existing IT, food-service, insurance and nursing catalog into North American admissions, U.S. high-school equivalency, regional passenger-vehicle licensing and Canadian citizenship.

content.nature: Original single-best-answer study questions. All passages and numerical scenarios are independently written. No official questions, affiliation, full-test simulation, adaptive behavior or score prediction is claimed.
content.references: Every question resolves to an HTTPS learning reference; regional rules use question-specific official references.
content.identityPolicy: Append after all 101 existing groups. Preserve all 190 existing catalog entries, question payloads, question IDs, choice IDs and version IDs. The new manifest records pre-change hashes checked by the unit suite.
content.storage: Existing public authored-content overlay; no hosted database writes or migrations.

scopeChecks: SAT exercises sample published domains. Reading drills include some shorter text than actual test passages; math exercises are multiple choice only.
GED sets are explicitly U.S. practice. GED testing is no longer available in Canada; the sets do not claim to prepare learners for CAEC. RLA does not score an essay.
Driving sets are jurisdiction-specific and describe signs in text. They do not claim to reproduce the official test format or supply complete legal guidance.

ICBC's October 19, 2026 update takes precedence over the older Learn to Drive Smart licence chapter: Class 7L supervisor minimum age is 22, with the updated immediate-family passenger exception. Both questions explicitly name the effective date and link to the current Class 7L page.
Ontario's advance flashing green and BC's pedestrian-controlled flashing green circle have different explanations and a regression assertion.

Citizenship practice avoids changing officeholder names, population estimates and test timing. It links to Discover Canada as the primary official resource and explains that the set is not exhaustive.

implementation: Ten readable English routes under /en/ with exam and jurisdiction terms in their slugs.
Unique search titles use Free, the exam name and Practice Test; H1 headings retain the actual exam identity.
Unique descriptions include 30 questions, answers and explanations, the 2026-10 set and subject-specific terms. Set metadata retains this copy instead of replacing it with a generic description.
Visible set summaries describe topics, jurisdiction, independent authorship and material limits.
The existing server-rendered English directory links every new exam. Set links and all prompts for each set page remain available without JavaScript.
The existing canonical, en/en-US/en-CA alternate, Open Graph, Twitter, breadcrumb and LearningResource paths cover the new sets.
Thirty sitemap URLs are added: ten exam roots, ten set landing pages and ten second set pages. Tracking parameters are omitted from canonical identities.
On-site aliases include digital SAT, GED RLA, CA DMV, MTO, ICBC, Class 7L, IRCC and Discover Canada. These are search aliases, not a keyword meta tag.
New School & equivalency, Driving and Citizenship filters make the enlarged English catalog navigable.
English home copy now represents SAT, GED, driving, citizenship and certification practice.
preserved: Production-only indexing and sitemap guards; local and protected environments remain noindex.
English-only new routes; no invented Korean translations or duplicate regional landing pages.
Direct question URLs remain noindex. Unknown set numbers and out-of-range pages return 404.
Existing production credentials, release checks, ads and consent behavior, and development-branch deployment suppression.
seo.limits: No keyword-volume data, Search Console data, country traffic or ranking measurements were available. Implementation improves content coverage and crawlable exam relevance; it does not guarantee indexing, rankings or user growth.

officialSourcesReviewed.accessNotes: Some Ontario direct reads returned HTTP 403; official indexed handbook and licensing excerpts were used. ICBC's full PDF exceeded the browser size limit; individual official chapters were read instead.
